title: Motor imagery dataset from Ma et al. 2020
description: EEG recordings from 25 healthy, BCI-naive right-handed participants performing motor imagery of two joints of the same limb (right hand and right elbow). Each participant completed 15 sessions over 3 days, giving 600 trials with 62-channel EEG sampled at 1000 Hz plus EOG. The dataset supports research on decoding fine-grained motor imagery within the same limb for motor rehabilitation and prosthetic control BCIs.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier using 62 scalp channels (standard 10-05 montage), a 1000 Hz sampling rate, AFz ground, and impedances below 5 kOhm. Each session contained 40 trials (20 hand, 20 elbow) with a 1 s visual cue followed by 4 s of kinesthetic motor imagery, without feedback. Participants completed 5 sessions per day over 3 days.
